youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

She spent three days stringing lights on the house for Diwali. Her sister's rangoli got the praise.

She: Jesus... I strung every light on our house for Diwali. Amma praised my sister’s rangoli. ✨
She: Three days on the ladder. She said “hmm, okay” and walked past.
Jesus: You did it for the house. And you wanted someone to see. Both are okay to say.
She: Is it childish to need that? Everyone else just does things quietly.
Jesus: Wanting to be seen is human. Being unseen today doesn’t erase the work.
Jesus: Don’t grow tired of doing good. The harvest comes even if Amma never counts your bulbs.

“Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.”
Galatians 6:9 (BSB)

Don’t grow tired of doing good. The harvest comes even if Amma never counts your bulbs.

💬 What did you do this week that nobody thanked you for? 👇
